request.absence: nil optional fields omitted; explicit false/empty preserved

response.field_mapping: all declared response item properties, optional fields preserve absence; provider cannot inject SDK ref
response.scope_checks: provider project/pool/account fields, when declared; mismatches rejected
response.timestamps: RFC3339 fields parsed; DB naive time retained as raw string
response.numbers: integer decimal bytes retained without float64

errors.403: permission_denied; never a successful empty collection
errors.limit: incomplete with bounded typed prefix and cursor

retry: bounded safe read, including audit POST

pagination.limits: MaxItems/MaxPages; one CollectionTimeout shared across all calls
pagination.continuation: bound to scope, generation, endpoint ID, semantic filters and contract revision
pagination.single_response: replay original page plus skip when locally truncated

inventory: metadata only; protected config/payload excluded; failed branch preserved and other branches continue
